title: Lecture 11 — Eigenvalues and eigenvectors
summary: Work from the characteristic equation to a basis of each eigenspace.
body: This study companion follows the official Module 4 guide, section 4.4 through Example 3. Solve $\det(A-\lambda I)=0$, then solve one homogeneous system per eigenvalue. Separate the eigenvalue (a scalar) from its eigenspace (a subspace). For a diagonal matrix, compare the algebra with the effect on the coordinate axes.
